summary: Round 36 recheck, 08:13-08:45Z 29 Sep. 0 Kaggle calls, no browser, local files only. Everything here is pre-score: at the 08:18:17Z header, exp89r (56656147) and exp75 (56656157) are still PENDING. The lens is saturated (131 earlier items; R32-R35 PI), so I picked the three old conclusions that probe 54 touches (exp89p = 0.956, SEC '-', 07:59Z). (A) R26-NF / R28-RC-B, 'the dummy-clip GT lab is never a sign read': PARTLY OVERTURNED. On non-coordinate levers it is now 3/3 on sign against the LB: K +0.0013 vs +0.002, SEC -0.0016 vs -0.002 (new), probe-10 secondary -0.007 vs -0.025. The LB/lab ratio is 1.25-1.5x. On CI it is still 0/2. Its pre-score prediction: exp89r displays 0.958 (0.957-0.959); DIS '+' and Rr '+' each have P ~0.05; A-M2 most likely UNUSED. (B) The A-M2 branch-A DIS code (R26-A2 / 02:53Z grid row 'd_R = 0.959 -> UNUSED'), which looks too strict once d_P = 0.956: UPHELD. In the lab, SEC costs less on the CI base (-0.0012) than on K (-0.0016), so dd is biased upward by ~+0.0004. A 0.959 read is explained by that interaction plus rounding. (C) 'No exp89t' (K + DIS 2.25 + CI, default since 28 Sep 15:43Z), revived because SEC '-' leaves exp89t as the only SEC-free way for DIS to reach a CI V_pub: UPHELD. The two instruments disagree on DIS (dummy lab +0.0005 vs the old 48-video lab -0.0007). A CI file must be submitted by ~09:30Z to be read before the tick, which is before any DIS read, and that breaks the user's 'winners only' condition. A display win over 0.959 would be mostly noise. No build, no slot and no rule change. Both free 29 Sep slots stay on MORNING TABLE v1.1 (A-M1 UNUSED; A-M2 by the logged function).

findings.what: OLD CONCLUSION: R26-NF-dummy-clip-gt-lab ('use it only as a gate sanity check, never as a sign read'), R28-RC-B ('the dummy lab moves 2-6 edges on one clip and is in-sample, so it cannot sign a lever'; SEC -0.0008..-0.0020 treated as 'a weak negative prior, not a sign') and R28-RC-C (3) ('never use the dummy lab as a sign read for coordinate-only changes'). WHAT CHANGED: probe 54 (exp89p, K + SEC) read 0.956 vs exp85a 0.958, i.e. -0.002. The lab's SEC-on-K arm was -0.0016. RECOMPUTED (tools/overlap_lab.pooled over all 16 dummy CSVs; lab vs LB): K (85a-70g) +0.00132 vs +0.002 RIGHT; SEC on K (89p-85a) -0.00160 vs -0.002 RIGHT; the earlier probe-10 secondary swap -0.007 vs -0.025 RIGHT; CI (79a-70g) -0.00549 vs probe 48 +0.001 WRONG; CI (87a-85a) -0.00509 vs probe 51 +0.001 WRONG. NEW VERDICT: PARTLY OVERTURNED. For detection and topology levers (K, SEC and secondaries; DIS is the same kind) the instrument has 3/3 signs right, with the LB about 1.25-1.5x the lab for K and SEC. Treat it as a directional prior for those levers. It stays unusable for coordinate levers (CI 0/2), so it says nothing about exp75 vs #37 (they differ only by CI). PRE-SCORE PREDICTION (logged before the exp89r read): exp89r - exp87a in the lab = -0.00079 (SEC on the CI base -0.00121, DIS +0.0004..+0.0005). Scaled, that is -0.0010..-0.0012 on the LB, so exp89r displays 0.958 centrally (range 0.957-0.959). Rr '+' and DIS '+' both need >= 0.960, P ~0.05. exp89s (K + DIS) lab = exp85a +0.00048, so it would display 0.958/0.959 and cannot pass 0.959 unless the true DIS effect is >= +0.0015. So A-M2 most likely resolves UNUSED, and that is the honest default.

findings.what: OLD CONCLUSION: MORNING TABLE v1.1 (1) branch A (R26-A2, 28 Sep 14:12Z) and the 02:53Z A-M2 grid: DIS '+' only if dd = (d_R - d_P) - (d_87a - d_85a) >= +0.002 AND exp89r > max(exp87a, exp89p); grid row 'd_R = 0.959 -> UNUSED for every d_P'. WHY IT LOOKS WRONG NOW: with d_P = 0.956 fixed (07:59Z), the dd clause alone would accept d_R = 0.959 (dd = 0.959 - 0.956 - 0.001 = +0.002). The 'beat max' clause then raises the bar to d_R >= 0.960 (dd >= +0.003), one notch stricter than the dd rule was written for. Read naively, a 0.959 would mean 'SEC -0.002 cancelled by DIS +0.002', and exp89s (K + DIS, non-CI) would then be expected at ~0.960, above V_pub. CHECK: the dd identity assumes SEC costs the same on the K base and the K + CI base. The lab says it does not: SEC on K -0.00160, SEC on CI (83c-79a) -0.00121, SEC on K + DIS -0.00169. So SEC is ~0.0004 cheaper once CI is present, and dd carries ~+0.0004 of SEC x CI interaction on top of DIS (lab DIS on K +0.00048). Add the four 3-decimal displays (up to +-0.002 of rounding) and a d_R = 0.959 is fully explained by interaction plus rounding at DIS ~ +0.0005. That is not enough for exp89s to beat 0.959 (see RC-A). NEW VERDICT: UPHELD. The strict clause is the right correction once d_P = 0.956. Do not relax the 0.959 row. The logged function stands: DIS '+' iff d_R >= 0.960 -> exp89s; Rr '+' with P '-' -> UNUSED; otherwise UNUSED.

It was verified only in a scratch mirror (76b898dd) and never built in experiments/. WHAT CHANGED: (1) SEC read '-' (probe 54), so exp89l, exp89r and exp89q are no longer V_pub routes. exp89t is the only SEC-free file that puts DIS on the CI V_pub line. (2) The dummy lab, now sign-calibrated for non-coordinate levers (RC-A), gives DIS on K +0.00048 and on K + SEC +0.00039, with 0 TP lost on K bases. That is roughly the mechanical node bonus (-0.7% nodes, about +0.0007 x J). (3) Two free slots are left on 29 Sep. CHECK: (a) exp87a's true score lies in [0.9585, 0.9595), so exp89t = exp87a + ~0.0006 would display 0.960 with P ~0.3-0.45. Most of that P comes from where exp87a sits unrounded, not from DIS, so switching V_pub on a 0.960 is largely a winner's-curse pick. (b) The only other lab with a sign record on this ILP axis (exp13, 48 videos; R26-RC-A) puts S 2.25 past its optimum (S ~1.66) at -0.0007. On the exp70g base DIS lost 1 TP and added 2 FP in the dummy lab. The prior is about 0 (-0.0007..+0.0007). (c) Timing: CI L is 9.30-9.48 h. To be read before the ~19:43Z notify and the 20:00Z tick, exp89t must be submitted by ~09:30-10:00Z, and build plus dummy takes 35-40 min. That means submitting before exp89r gives any DIS read, which breaks the user's 12:25Z 'morning = stack of the night winners' condition. (d) The exp89r read cannot isolate DIS cleanly anyway (RC-B). NEW VERDICT: UPHELD. No exp89t build, no dummy and no question to the user. Keep the ~2.2 h of GPU and the free slots unused unless A-M2 fires.
